title: Save-key ledger (packs/<game>/<faction>/<class>/save-keys.json)
description: Every key a save of one guide pack can hold (0.9 P10), written by `npm run gen` and committed, like data/DATA_SOURCES.md; never edited by hand. Each group maps a key to the name of what it tracks. The generator compares the data against the committed ledger: a key that leaves the data needs a retired.json entry (the faction's or the class's), and a key whose record now carries another key (same group, same name) needs that entry's renamedTo. Objective keys are <story key>#<i>, a sub-step <story key>#<i>.<j> (explicit sub indices only).
